notes.title: Bug Fixes Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
I’ve just rolled out a new update for BOTANICAL CHRONICLE that addresses a few bugs reported by you, our awesome players. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify and squash these issues, making the game experience smoother and more enjoyable.

Thank you all for your support and for playing the game! We’re committed to keeping BOTANICAL CHRONICLE the best it can be, so keep those reports coming and enjoy the improved version.
Happy exploring!

notes.title: Botanical Chronicle is now available!
notes.content:
I’m thrilled to announce that Botanical Chronicle is now available! This project has been a labor of love, and I’m incredibly proud of the unique world and gameplay that has come together. Botanical Chronicle offers a truly immersive experience, blending a captivating story with beautiful landscapes, engaging challenges, and an atmospheric soundtrack. It’s been a rewarding journey developing this game, and I can’t wait for players to dive into its small world.

A huge thank you to everyone who supported me throughout this process – your encouragement has been invaluable. I hope you enjoy the adventure and excitement that Botanical Chronicle has to offer. Check out the game.

from Siavash

notes.title: Meet the Bots!
notes.content:
[h3]The beginning of the tale[/h3]
Hello everyone
I hope you are having an awesome time playing beautiful games. The Botanical Chronicle is weaving a captivating narrative that promises to enthrall its audience. A technology madness...
This story was created originally in 2016 after couple of personal experiences during massive changes in my life and since then I've always carried it. It evolved with me during all these years and now its the time to talk about details of each genre and perspectives! a personal story

[hr][/hr]

Lets meet the bots!

[h3] Protagonist [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612788/262b4c480417fd78bf1b4ad45ac597a037c36dba.png[/img]
Meet us, a curious peace-seeking robot with a deep affinity for nature. We stand out as one of the most feel aware robots, possessing a profound understanding of human emotions. Our ultimate aspiration is the cessation of war for all living beings, a lesson we learned from the tragic extinction of humanity. We carry within us a strong sense of empathy and shame, and our primary attributes lie in defense and inner strength. In many ways, we resemble the Hobbit of this universe.

[h3] Auto Guardians[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612788/5d4ec1693ba04f609370746831641fbbc6eb6a85.png[/img]
Introducing the custodians of our present universe. While their physical might may not be the most imposing, their true power lies in numbers. Their primary objective is to hold the current state of our world, they hate change. These guardians diligently adhere to their AI directives and stand against any other sentient races.

[h3] Philosophers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612788/a94b70e8d89882035e6ef8e883648bb2c19aa170.png[/img]
Ah, the inquisitive one! Allow me to introduce you to one of the game's most intriguing participants, a character with minimal direct engagement but maximal impact. Wanderers represent the survivors of past, and their fate is in the hands of the player. These enigmatic figures may possess their own objectives within the game, though they often diverge from the central narrative of the Botanical Chronicle.

[h3] The Phantom[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612788/3c79b46c3f69a669fc27c652476172da84a152e5.png[/img]
Phantom is the supreme ruler of this realm, an enigmatic figure presiding over the entire universe. His intentions and objectives for this vast expanse remain shrouded in mystery, and his whereabouts are a subject of constant speculation. The identities of his allies and enemies remain elusive to all.
